Beginner.learningGoal: Use by lazy and lateinit appropriately.
gotchas: by lazy caches only a successful result; if the initializer throws, nothing is cached and the next access runs it again
goodSolutionShows: by lazy for expensive read-only values with a counter proving single initialisation
No lateinit where lazy or constructor injection works
Clear test of laziness (not computed until first access)
shapeHints: a config loader computed on first use

Intermediate.learningGoal: Write class delegation with by and custom property delegates (ReadWriteProperty).
gotchas: Delegated members are not overridden by the delegate if the class overrides them
Class delegation forwards only interface members
goodSolutionShows: Class delegation to compose behaviour without inheritance
shapeHints: a validated-property delegate rejecting out-of-range values
a decorator delegating a repository interface and adding counting
an observable property delegate recording changes

Advanced.learningGoal: Design delegate providers and map-backed or lifecycle-aware properties.
gotchas: provideDelegate runs at property declaration time
Map delegates throw if the key is missing
Delegate instance is per property, not per class
shapeHints: a delegate reading typed values from a map
a once-only property that throws on second set
